title: MAP: POC Networking & Org Setup — gating checkpoints and close timeline
text:
MAP: POC Networking & Org Setup — gating checkpoints and close timeline

['From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@averyhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC Networking & Org Setup — gating checkpoints and close timeline

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I’ve attached a lightweight MAP tracker that maps the POC gating items to owners and dates. For this phase we’re focused on the environment essentials that unblock the evaluation:

- Org setup: creation of Avery Health service account / org entry and admin contact
- API keys: issuance of scoped API key for the POC tenant (ephemeral preferred)
- IP allowlist: list of public egress IPs to allow to 3rd-party services (we’ve attached our suggested CIDR set)
- VPC peering: high-level peering checklist and config template (we’ll provide peer ASN and exact routes once the peering window is booked)

Requested next steps / asks (can you confirm by EOD Thursday?):
1) Confirm the Avery contact who will own org creation and whether we should create the service account from our side or you’ll provision it. Please provide an email for the service account principal.
2) Share the final allowlist CIDRs (we attached a preliminary list — please update and return).
3) Proposed 2-hour VPC peering window (we suggest Weds 3/23 10:00–12:00 PT) so infra teams can coordinate.
4) Any procurement checklist items (SOW/PO) that would affect booking peering or issuing keys.

Attachments: MAP_checkpoint_tracker.xlsx (MAP tracker), allowlist_ips_v1.csv (suggested CIDRs)

I’ll loop in Ben (network lead) on the peering details. Neha — FYI on timeline so we can align contract/credits if needed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: MAP_checkpoint_tracker.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), allowlist_ips_v1.csv (text/csv)', 'From: Samira Khan <samira.k@averyhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Health IT <it@averyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC Networking & Org Setup — gating checkpoints and close timeline

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear list and the tracker. Quick answers from the Avery side:

- I’ll be the executive owner for the MAP and will own coordination.
- Org/service account: our infra team prefers to provision the service account for audit reasons; contact for that activity will be it@averyhealth.com (they’ve been CC’d).
- IP allowlist: attaching our internal outgoing NAT ranges separately (we have a couple of managed egress IPs).
- Peering window: 3/23 10:00–12:00 PT looks OK, but our SRE asks if we can do 3/24 08:00–10:00 PT instead to avoid a deployment that day.

We don’t have procurement stalls — we can accept the POC SOW terms you sent earlier. I’ll return the updated allowlist and a point-of-contact for the service account owner by EOD Wed.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Director, Platform Integrations | Avery Health
samira.k@averyhealth.com

> Hi Samira —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I’ve attached a lightweight MAP tracker...

Attachment: (Avery reply included their internal NAT ranges as an inline list)', 'From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@averyhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC Networking & Org Setup — gating checkpoints and close timeline

Samira / Marissa —

Thanks for the updates, Samira. A few technical clarifications so we can prepare the peering runbook:

1) Peering details we will need from your side before the session:
   - Peer ASN (if you are using an ASN) or confirmation you’ll accept our public-facing peering endpoint
   - Desired route advertisement scope / specific prefixes to accept
   - Any forced-tunneled ports (we only allow specific management ports during peering configuration)
2) Firewall / NAT expectations: please confirm whether your egress NATs are static. If they are dynamic we’ll need a short maintenance window for testing.
3) Service account: if your team creates it, please add the principal marissa.cole@redwood.ai as a temporary admin so we can finish onboarding tasks and issue the scoped API key. We will rotate credentials immediately after the POC.

I’ve attached a concise peering config template to make the session efficient. Proposed runbook for the peering window (adjustable):
- 00:00–00:15: confirm endpoints, ASN, and IPs
- 00:15–00:45: apply routes & ACLs in staging mirror
- 00:45–01:15: smoke tests (token exchange, API calls, KV cache tests)
- 01:15–02:00: rollback verification & signoff

If 3/24 08:00–10:00 PT is preferred by Avery, we can do that — please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and who must attend.

Ben Carter
Network Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: peering_config_template.txt (text/plain)', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@averyhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Mar 2027 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC Networking & Org Setup — gating checkpoints and close timeline

Samira —

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the agreed plan and owners so we can mark the MAP tracker:

- Org/service-account: Avery infra (it@averyhealth.com). Marissa (exec owner) will coordinate internal approvals. (Owner: Avery infra)
- API key issuance: Redwood will issue a scoped ephemeral key once the service account principal is created and temporary admin access is granted. (Owner: Redwood: marissa.cole@redwood.ai)
- IP allowlist: Avery to return final CIDRs by EOD Wed 3/18. (Owner: Avery IT)
- VPC peering: scheduled for Thu 3/24 08:00–10:00 PT. Agenda will follow; Ben + two Avery SREs requested. (Owner: Redwood & Avery SREs)

I’ve updated the MAP tracker in Drive with these owners and tentative dates (link below). I’ll create the calendar invite for 3/24 and add the runbook as an attachment. If procurement needs any final signature, loop Neha for credits/PO handling.

Links & next artifacts:
- MAP tracker (updated): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/abc123-mappoc
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/AWY-2027-38

Thanks everyone — we’ll aim to close the POC activation checklist the week of 3/28 after peering is validated.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
